Name: Curtain Fall
Description: Be it with a flamboyant hand gesture or an eccentric bow, you summon a curtain around you to hide your form as you teleport towards an unoccupied space within 15-ft. of you. As part of casting this spell you may take the Hide action, taking advantage of the sudden vanishing.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may teleport up to 10-ft. further for each slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher you have advantage on the Stealth check of your next Hide action.
